hint.selectFirst: Select one or more masses first

place.direction: Click the direction (or type a length) — Esc to finish

line.next: Click the next point — Enter or double-click to finish, click the first point to close, Backspace removes the last point

polygon.next: Click the next point — Enter or click the first point to close

move.second: Click the target point (or type a distance)

copy.second: Click the target point (or type a distance)

rotate.second: Click the target direction (or type an angle in degrees)

mirror.first: Mirror: click the first axis point

array.second: Click the point defining the spacing

green.first: Vegetation zone: click the first point of the outline

align.first: Align: click the reference (façade, site boundary, building, zone)
align.facade: Click the façade to align (Shift+click: move the whole volume)
align.volume: Click the façade of the volume to align
align.impossible: This façade cannot be aligned (staggered sections) — use a parallel reference or the whole volume

edit.storeysHint: Drag up/down or ▲ ▼ to change the number of storeys
edit.typeWhileDragging: Type a value + Enter · Alt: no magnet · Esc cancels
edit.typeToCorrect: Type a value + Enter to correct
